source_clause: PRACC5.1) If there are memory seat buttons, there will be a default Driver Profile for each memory seat position/button (e.g., if there are 2 memory seat buttons there will be two default Profiles: memory seat button 1 defaults as linked to “Driver 1” Profile, and memory seat button two defaults as linked to “Driver 2” Profile)
leaf_desc_037: PRACC5.1) If there are memory seat buttons, there will be a default Driver Profile for each memory seat position/button (e.g., if there are 2 memory seat buttons there will be two default Profiles: memory seat button 1 defaults as linked to “Driver 1” Profile, and memory seat button two defaults as linked to “Driver 2” Profile)
reasoning: 驗證目標：4.5.1（PRACC5.1）—— 有記憶座椅鍵時，每個座椅位置各有一個預設 Driver Profile。關鍵情境條件：座椅鍵數以條文之例（2）固定，且無自訂 profile —— 否則預設之數目會被自訂者干擾。為什麼這樣切：**ER 逐一指名兩個連結**（Driver 1 ↔ 鍵 1、Driver 2 ↔ 鍵 2）；只驗「有兩個預設 profile」，一個把兩者都連到同一鍵之實作會通過。刻意略過：座椅鍵三個以上之情形條文未述（§8.4.1 保留）。

tcs.tc_title: One default Profile per memory seat button
tcs.test_item:
One default Profile per memory seat button

(Verifies that each memory seat position has its own default Driver Profile)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The vehicle has 2 memory seat buttons
2. No custom Driver Profile is set up on the vehicle
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the “All Profiles” tab
2. Read the seat links and check that each button has its own default Profile
tcs.expected_result:
1. The “All Profiles” tab is displayed
2. Two default Profiles are present: “Driver 1” linked to memory seat button 1 and “Driver 2” linked to memory seat button 2
tcs.priority_basis: 每個記憶座椅位置之預設 profile；配置相依之分支
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.remarks: 條文以「2 個座椅鍵」為例（e.g.），本 TC 以其為 pre-condition ——**該數字取自條文之例，非自擬**。座椅鍵 ≥ 3 之情形條文未述，依 §8.4.1 不推定。
